Jr. IT Solutions Associate
Location: Vikhroli, Mumbai
Employment Type: Full-Time (Onsite)
Experience: Fresher – 1 year
Job Description
The Junior IT Solutions Associate will support the IT solutions and client engagement
function by identifying client needs, presenting the right technology solutions, and assisting
in proposal development. The role requires strong communication skills, curiosity about IT
products, and the ability to coordinate with internal teams to deliver accurate solutions.
This position is ideal for freshers who want to build a career in IT solutioning, consulting,
and client interaction.
Roles & Responsibilities
1. Client Requirement Analysis
- Interact with potential clients to understand their technical and business needs and
document key requirements.
2. Solution Presentation
- Assist in preparing and delivering product demos, presentations, and basic solution
explanations to clients.
3. Proposal & Documentation Support
- Support the creation of solution proposals, technical documents, and initial quotations in
coordination with internal teams.
4. Lead Coordination & Reporting
- Manage and track assigned leads through CRM, follow up with prospects, and provide
regular updates to the reporting manager.
5. Cross-Team Collaboration
- Work with technical, product, and implementation teams to validate solution feasibility
and support handover processes.
6. Continuous Learning
- Upgrade knowledge on company products, IT technologies, and industry trends through
ongoing training.
Required Skills
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Basic understanding of IT concepts and software solutions
- Proficiency in MS Office and documentation
Qualification :-
• Bachelor’s degree in an IT-related field is required (B.Tech/B.E in Computer Science or IT,
BCA, MCA, B.Sc IT, or equivalent).
